name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Plant your feet and pinch the shoulder blades.
Lower the bar to the mid-chest.
Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows.

name: Incline Barbell Press
cues: Touch the bar high on the chest.
Drive the bar back over the shoulders.

name: Decline Barbell Press
cues: Hook the feet and keep the hips down.
Press without flaring the elbows wide.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Start with the bells over the chest.
Lower until the elbows are just below the bench.
Press the bells up and slightly inward.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Keep the bench at a modest incline.
Lower the bells beside the upper chest.
Press until the arms are long, not locked hard.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cues: Soft bend in the elbows stays fixed.
Open only until the chest stretches.
Sweep the bells back together over the chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
cues: Open the arms with a soft elbow.
Squeeze the chest as the bells meet.

name: Cable Crossover
cues: Step forward so the cables stay loaded.
Bring the hands together in front of the chest.

name: Low Cable Fly
cues: Arc the handles up toward the chest.

name: Pec Deck
cues: Match the seat so the elbows stay at chest height.
Squeeze until the arms are in front of you.
Do not let the stack slam.

name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Set the seat so the handles start at chest height.
Press until the elbows are almost straight.

name: Push-Up
cues: Chest travels to the floor, then press away.

name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Hands form a diamond under the chest.
Elbows track back, not straight out.

name: Chest Dip
cues: Lower until the shoulders are near the elbows.

name: Landmine Press
cues: Press the bar up and slightly in.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Brace, then push the floor away.
Keep the bar touching the legs.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge until the torso is near parallel.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs.
Lower it without rounding the back.

name: Pendlay Row
cues: Reset the bar on the floor each rep.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Brace the free hand on a bench.
Pull the bell to the hip.

name: Chest-Supported Row
cues: Pull the bells toward the hips.
Pause at the top without shrugging.

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull the bar to the upper chest.
Let the shoulders rise on the way up.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Lead with the elbows down and out.

name: Pull-Up
cues: Pull the chest toward the bar.
Lower until the arms are straight.

name: Chin-Up
cues: Pull until the chin clears the bar.

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a soft knee bend.
Pull the handle to the ribs.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Pull the bar down to the thighs.
Feel the lats, not a shrug.

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Pull the handle into the stomach.

name: Meadows Row
cues: Row the end of the bar to the hip.

name: Inverted Row
cues: Body is a straight line under the bar.
Pull the chest to the bar.
Lower until the arms are long.

name: Rack Pull
cues: Bar starts just below the knee.
Don't lean back at the top.

name: Overhead Press
cues: Bar starts on the front of the shoulders.
Press it to finish over the mid-foot.
Head comes through at the top.

name: Arnold Press
cues: Rotate the palms out as you press.
Reverse the path on the way down.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with the elbows, not the hands.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Raise the arm out to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cues: Raise one or both bells to eye level.

name: Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge until the chest faces the floor.

name: Face Pull
cues: Set the rope at face height.
Pull toward the nose and finish hands wide.
Pause with the shoulders externally rotated.

name: Upright Row
cues: Pull the bar to the lower chest.

name: Push Press
cues: Dip the knees a few inches.
Drive the bar overhead with the legs.

name: Bradford Press
cues: Lower it behind, then back in front.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Open the arms to the sides.

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Hold the bar at the thighs.

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Lower until the arms are straight.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Squeeze at the top without leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Supinate the palm as you lift.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Lie on an incline so the arms hang back.
Curl without moving the upper arm.
Feel the stretch at the bottom.

name: Preacher Curl
cues: Upper arms stay on the pad.
Lower until the elbow is nearly straight.
Don't bounce out of the bottom.

name: Concentration Curl
cues: Brace the elbow on the inner thigh.
Curl the bell to the shoulder.

name: Cable Curl
cues: Curl the bar without letting the elbows drift.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
cues: Arm is slightly behind the body.

name: Spider Curl
cues: Curl and pause at the top.

name: Zottman Curl
cues: Rotate palms down at the top.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
cues: Curl the rope toward the ears.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
cues: Set the seat so the armpits meet the pad.

name: Waiter Curl
cues: Hold one bell with both hands under the plate.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Elbows stay closer to the ribs.
Touch the lower chest and press.

name: Skull Crusher
cues: Lower toward the forehead, then extend.

name: Cable Pushdown
cues: Pin the elbows to the sides.
Don't let the shoulders roll forward.

name: Rope Pushdown
cues: Split the rope at the bottom.
Control the return to the chest.

name: Overhead Cable Extension
cues: Bend the elbows behind the head.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cues: Lower until the elbows are near 90 degrees.
Press up to a tall lockout.

name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on a bench behind you.
Lower the hips by bending the elbows.
Don't let the shoulders dump forward.

name: Dumbbell Kickback
cues: Hinge and pin the upper arm.

name: JM Press
cues: Lower the bar toward the chin and upper chest.

name: Tate Press
cues: Bells start over the chest, palms forward.
Bend the elbows out and down.

name: French Press
cues: Lie down and start with the bar over the shoulders.

name: Machine Dip
cues: Set the seat so the hands start near the shoulders.
Press down until the arms are straight.

name: Reverse-Grip Pushdown
cues: Press the bar down and squeeze.

name: Wrist Curl
cues: Lower until the fingers open slightly.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
cues: Lift the back of the hand.

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
cues: Hold the bar behind the thighs.

name: Towel Hang
cues: Hang from a towel over a bar.

name: Dead Hang
cues: Hang from a bar with a full grip.

name: Finger Curl
cues: Let the bar roll to the fingers.
Curl it back into the palm.

name: Barbell Hold
cues: Hold a heavy bar at the thighs.

name: Dumbbell Pronation
cues: Hold the bell at one end.
Rotate the palm down and up.

name: Wrist Roller
cues: Roll the rope up with the wrists.
Arms stay in front of you.

name: Thick-Bar Hold
cues: Hold at the sides or in front.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Curl
cues: This loads the forearm and brachialis.

name: Radial Deviation
cues: Hold the bell like a hammer, thumb up.
Tilt the wrist toward the thumb.

name: Suitcase Carry
cues: Carry one bell at the side.

name: Front Squat
cues: Squat to depth you can own.

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the bell at the chest.
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

name: Leg Press
cues: Lower until the knees are near 90 degrees.

name: Leg Extension
cues: Pad sits on the lower shin.

name: Walking Lunge
cues: Back knee travels toward the floor.

name: Hack Squat
cues: Squat down with the back on the pad.

name: Sissy Squat
cues: Use a support until you own it.

name: Step-Up
cues: Drive up without pushing off the back leg.

name: Spanish Squat
cues: Band behind the knees, anchored low.
The band helps the knees track.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand by driving the hips through.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
cues: Less knee bend than an RDL.
Stop when the back wants to round.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Curl the heels to the glutes.

name: Nordic Curl
cues: Catch yourself with the hands if needed.

name: Good Morning
cues: Bar on the back, knees soft.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand tall on the working leg.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
cues: Curl the heels and extend the hips.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Bells in front of the thighs.

name: 45-Degree Back Extension
cues: Raise until the body is straight, not past it.

name: Hip Thrust
cues: Ribs stay down at the top.
Pause when the hips are tall.

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Squeeze without arching the lower back.

name: Frog Pump
cues: Lift the hips in a small range.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cues: Push the floor apart and stand.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Hinge and let the cable pull the hips back.

name: Lateral Band Walk
cues: Step sideways without letting the knees cave.

name: Donkey Kick
cues: Kick the heel toward the ceiling.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
cues: Drive that hip up and pause.

name: Curtsy Lunge
cues: Step one foot behind and across.

name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on the edge.
Lower the heels below the step.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Pause at the top and the bottom.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on the bottom of the platform.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cues: Bar on the back, toes on a plate.

name: Tibialis Raise
cues: Heels on the floor, toes up.
Lift the toes toward the shins.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
cues: Bell in one hand, other hand on a wall.

name: Eccentric Calf Drop
cues: Lower on one for a slow count.

name: Band Calf Raise
cues: Band under the feet, held in the hands.

name: Farmer Calf Raise
cues: Hold the bells at the sides.

name: Stair Calf Walk
cues: Walk up on the balls of the feet.
Use a rail if you need it.

name: Dead Bug
cues: Reach the opposite arm and leg.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Lower until the body is long.

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Crunch the ribs toward the hips.

name: Ab Wheel
cues: Roll out until the hips want to sag.

name: Russian Twist
cues: Rotate the ribs, not just the arms.
Feet down if the back tires.

name: Pallof Press
cues: Don't let the cable rotate you.

name: Mountain Climber
cues: Drive one knee in, then the other.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Hands under the hips if needed.
Lower without the back arching hard.

name: V-Up
cues: Arms and legs meet over the hips.

name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Curl the hips off the floor.

name: Burpee
cues: Step or jump to a plank.
Add a jump only if the landing is quiet.

name: Thruster
cues: Drive straight into an overhead press.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
cues: The bell rests on the forearm, not the wrist.

name: Devil Press
cues: Swing them overhead as you stand.

name: Turkish Get-Up
cues: Move from the floor to standing in steps.

name: Renegade Row
cues: Row one bell to the hip.

name: Man Maker
cues: Push-up, row each side, then squat to press.
Use lighter bells than you row.

name: Bear Complex
cues: Clean, front squat, push press, back squat, push press.

name: Dumbbell Clean
cues: Pull and catch at the shoulders.

name: Sandbag Clean
cues: Catch it in the arms at the chest.

name: Wall Ball
cues: Throw it to a target as you stand.

name: Farmer Carry Complex
cues: Carry, then shrug, then a short march.

name: Rowing Machine
cues: Don't round the back at the catch.

name: Assault Bike
cues: Keep a rhythm you can hold.

name: Jump Rope
cues: Stay on the balls of the feet.

name: Shadow Boxing
cues: Turn the hips with the punch.

name: Box Step
cues: Step up and down one foot at a time.

name: Pool Laps
cues: Rest at the wall if the stroke breaks.
